scope: Two new attached filter feeders, model portraits, identification practice, guide entries and modest dive encounters; five sourced connections among existing species.
modelLimits: Posed dimensions, counts, placement and subtle motion are illustration choices. Reported collection depths are not physiological limits. Neither new species is given coral bleaching states. The worm crown is not a complete taxonomic key.

species.support: WoRMS accepted name; Hawaii tunicate anatomy and larval chordate features; Herwin et al. 2026 p132 documented two siphons and colour variation; SeaLifeBase reported Indo-West Pacific, 3-20m and Not Evaluated. No medicinal claims included.

population.meaning: Illustrative encounter counts, not abundance estimates.

verification.models: Both models visually reviewed in high/low detail and alternate angles; two draws each, reduced-motion and disposal tests pass. High detail worm uses a specific 16000-triangle cap for curved pinnules; existing species caps are unchanged.
verification.focusedTests: Catalog, population, role collections, field marks, source links, practice, real/fallback anchoring, geometry, draw batches, connections, navigation and i18n checks pass.
verification.browser: 9 desktop/phone guide and connection checks plus 7 focused live-dive checks passed with no browser/shader/network errors. Whole-scene census verified 76 living species and 239 organism groups; both new organisms can be located without awarding identification credit.
verification.limits: The exhaustive whole-catalog bleaching/material-family test timed out, including an isolated temporary 300-second retry; its other nine checks passed.
